snippet.title: Vusi Thembekwayo
snippet.description:
I'm Vusi Thembekwayo, a global business strategist and venture capitalist who architects disruption, not just talks about it.
For over a decade, I've delivered over 480 keynotes across six continents, from the Oxford Union to Harvard, and to sold-out arenas in New York, London, and Dubai. I've sat in boardrooms with Fortune 500 CEOs making decisions that drive real transformation.
As founder & CEO of MyGrowthFund Venture Partners, I back exceptional founders building scalable businesses across Africa and beyond. I was a Dragon investor at 28, a JSE-listed company director before most people finish their MBA, and the youngest African entrepreneur to appear on the cover of Entrepreneur Magazine. I also featured on CNBC, Bloomberg, and Inc. 500.
Here, you'll gain unfiltered insights into leadership, strategy, disruption, and the founder's mindset. Real strategies for navigating chaos, scaling ventures, and leading with conviction. Not theory. What actually works when the stakes are high.

snippet.title: Sandeep Swadia
snippet.description:
From homeless to billion-dollar boardrooms. From monk training to MIT. From stage concerts to M&A... I’ve lived more lives than a cat.

I've served as CEO and C-level exec at tech companies that created $40B+ in value. I also crashed and burned too. Failure teaches much faster than success.

Before business, I performed 1,000+ concerts with Grammy winners. As a teenager, I ran away from home, trained as a monk, and somehow ended up graduating from MIT. 

I started this channel to share guidance my 22-year-old self desperately needed but never got. Science, strategy, spirituality, and stories from your friend who’s been there, warts and all.

Currently, I live in the NYC area, serving on boards, advising AI startups and help ambitious leaders scale without losing themselves.

It's so awesome to see you here. Thank you, and I love you.

For brand partnerships,  podcast appearances, and speaking engagements, please reach out to Creative Artists Agency (CAA) at SwadiaSandeepGroup@CAA.com.

snippet.title: Philip VanDusen
snippet.description:
About Philip...
With over 25 years of experience as a creative executive in strategic branding and graphic design, Philip has worked for some of the world's most successful global retailers, consumer products companies and branding firms. He brings to his clients and followers a unique blend of expertise gained from leading creative teams from both the client-side and agency-side perspectives.

 As the Owner of Verhaal Brand Design, a branding consultancy in New Jersey, Philip’s agency specializes in brand strategy, graphic design and marketing for an international roster of clients.

Previously, Philip served as VP of Design for Global Snacks at PepsiCo, VP of Design at Old Navy and Executive Creative Director at the iconic branding firm Landor Associates. Past clients include Pepsico, P&G, Kraft Foods, Merck, Petsmart, Safeway, Chevron, Levi's Strauss & Co., Microsoft, Campbell’s and Johnson & Johnson among dozens of others.

snippet.title: Liam Ottley
snippet.description:
I’m an AI entrepreneur from New Zealand. In 2023 I created the 'AI Automation Agency' or 'AAA' model based on my learnings at my own agency Morningside AI.

On this channel I share my learnings from running my own AI Automation Agency, AI SaaS and from helping my community of over 300,000 AI Automation Agency owners to start and scale their own AI business.

My mission is to inspire others to take advantage of the incredible AI opportunity by documenting my journey as an AI entrepreneur.

snippet.title: Nick Saraev
snippet.description:
Hi 👋 I'm Nick. I've helped millions of people learn cutting-edge technology like Claude Code, Codex, N8N, & Antigravity. 

I first started in the agency world, founding two service businesses that scaled to a combined $160,000/m in revenue. Since then, I've worked with multibillion dollar enterprises, like Anthropic, Wix, and MrBeast (among many others!)

This channel is a way for me to organize my thoughts while providing a guidepost for people that want to improve their AI skills, build an online business, and stay ahead of the rapid changes in both technology and the economy.

To that end, you'll find Claude Code tutorials, Antigravity guides, n8n courses, sales masterclasses, and really anything I find interesting or impactful on a day-to-day basis.

If you have any questions, feel free to ask and I'll happily respond in the comments! Thanks for reading.
